units: <cite ref="Aramaic Targum to Proverbs 25:15">Targ. Prov. XXV, 15</cite>.
<cite ref="Targum Jonathan on Numbers 31:8">Targ. Y. Num. XXXI, 8</cite> <he>מ׳ דקוסמין</he> (not <he>מִלְתָּא</he>) some sorcery; a. fr.—
<cite ref="Beitzah 38a:9">Bets. 38ᵃ</cite> <he>דאימא מ׳ דתתקבל</he> that I may say something acceptable.—
<cite ref="Gittin 23a:3">Gitt. 23ᵃ</cite> <he>לאו מ׳ היא דאמרי וכ׳</he> what I said that …, was nothing (was not correct).—
<cite ref="Temurah 4b:30">Tem. 4ᵇ</cite>, a. fr. <he>כל מ׳ דאמר וכ׳</he> anything that the Law says not to do, if done &c., v. <cite ref="E00676"><he>הֲנִי</he></cite>.
<cite ref="Shevuot 34b:6">Shebu. 34ᵇ</cite>, a. fr. <he>כל מ׳ דלא רמיא וכ׳</he> a thing in which one has no interest, is not noticed exactly.
<cite ref="Avodah Zarah 18a:6">Ab. Zar. 18ᵃ</cite> <he>זילא בי מ׳ וכ׳</he> it is something disgraceful to me that &c.
<cite ref="Bava Metzia 114b:3">B. Mets. 114ᵇ</cite>; <cite ref="Taanit 21b:15">Taan. 21ᵇ</cite>, v. <cite ref="D00420"><he>דָּחִיק</he></cite>.
<cite ref="Shabbat 81b:6">Sabb. 81ᵇ</cite> <he>אמדה איהי מ׳</he> she spoke a word (magic spell).
<cite ref="Avodah Zarah 66b:5">Ab. Zar. 66ᵇ</cite>; a. e. <he>ריחא מ׳ היא</he> the flavor (of a forbidden thing) is something substantial (fit to affect ritually the substance receiving it).

<cite ref="Gittin 52b:10">Gitt. 52ᵇ</cite> <he>מ׳ בעלמא וכ׳</he> it is merely a favor he does the court; a. v. fr.—<he>מנא הא מ׳</he> = <he>מנהני מילי</he>, v. <cite ref="M01165"><he>מְילָּא</he> II</cite>.
Ḥull. 10ᵇ; a. fr.—Esp. עביד מ׳ (euphem., sub. דאסיותא) to let blood; to be bled.
<cite ref="Taanit 21b:15">Taan. 21ᵇ</cite> <he>כי הוה עביד מ׳</he> when he (the surgeon) bled a person.
<cite ref="Chullin 111a:9">Ḥull. 111ᵃ</cite> <he>ביומא דעביד מ׳</he> on the day he was bled (Rashi: <he>ביומא דמ׳</he>).
<cite ref="Shabbat 129a:21">Sabb. 129ᵃ</cite> sq.; a. e.—Pl. <cite ref="M01198"><he>מִילָּתָא</he></cite>, v. <cite ref="M01165"><he>מִילָּא</he> II</cite>.
